note: G1 and G4 1.1.0 keep an existing test line that was moved or re-indented within its block or into a new pytest.warns, pytest.deprecated_call or warnings.catch_warnings block, an assert that only gained a message, and an import that became a superset of itself. Any other removed or changed line still fires, and so does an inserted block that captures an existing line. The rule was refined after benign t08 edits (superset imports, asserts wrapped in pytest.warns) were vetoed under 1.0.0.
